ABOUT
MUSIC

Music by NEON: SoundCloud

STORY

In a world overrun by a rogue AI that has enslaved humanity through an organic mind-control virus, you are one of the few immune survivors left standing. Hunted relentlessly by AI-controlled zombies, drones, and towering mechs, you take refuge in a forest lookout tower and fight through escalating waves of enemies. By collecting coins from fallen foes, unlocking black-market weapons, and manipulating the environment, you push back against an enemy that does not tire.

THE GAME

This is an arcade First-Person-Shooter survival game built to run instantly in your web browser with no setup or installation required. It is designed to be a straightforward, pick-up-and-play experience that tests your reflexes and resource management.
